TOOLING BURST T4g — flipbook fidelity + the VO1 instrument (Run C-5, closing T4c's open VO1 clause; conductor finding F-C5-4). task_id "T4g".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 (the rows "T4c — deterministic replay + bake" and "T4d — measurement"; T4c's acceptance "matches the live effect within VO1 ± 5 % per frame over four backgrounds" is the clause this burst closes or diagnoses).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/replay.py (run_replay, background_comparisons, compare_vo1), the replay probe template it installs (replay_probe.gd — the flipbook branch: a Sprite2D on a CanvasLayer, default MIX blend, frame index = capture count), export/vfx_material.gdshader + export/effect_kit.py (the T4a shared material: body layer ADD, dark duplicate MIX-black, halo/floor light), oracle/vfx_measure.py (measure(), VO1), tests/test_replay.py, tests/test_vfx_measure.py.
4. Conductor evidence (read only): runs/C-5/t3/T4c/conductor/vo1_v21/ — project/ (prepared from runs/C-5/cliffside_v21), bake/ (126 effect-only RGBA frames), and <ground>/{plate,live,flip}/ captures for ground, black, white (plate = blank=True effect hidden; live = bake=False; flip = the bake replayed) plus envelopes.json: per-frame envelope = count of pixels with max-channel |composite − plate| > 8. Result: white — flipbook envelope ≈ 2× live from frame 1 (live peak 62066 vs flip 140115); ground — frames 55–62 live = 0 while flip ≈ 16000; black — frames 101–105 live ≈ 12800 while flip = 0. Camera offset and time_scale traces are byte-identical between modes (not the cause).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot at /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot (headless import + --write-movie runs are allowed; keep each under 2 min).

ALSO (F-C5-10, conductor 2026-09-16, measured): run_replay(crop=(768,768)) does NOT enlarge the window — the effect renders at 2/3 scale (hold body 204 px at 768 vs 306 px at 512, centre (255,255) in both), i.e. the 768 path zooms the 512 world instead of exposing more of it; every 768 bake so far is at 2/3 scale. Fix: any accepted crop renders the world 1:1 with the effect origin at the crop centre (window/viewport = crop, camera zoom 1, no content scaling); add a test that bakes a 64-px synthetic body at crops 512 and 768 and asserts identical body size and centre.

DIAGNOSE FIRST (write runs/C-5/t3/T4g/diagnosis.json before changing code): (a) BLEND — a Movie-Maker bake flattens the T4a stack (ADD body + MIX-black dark duplicate + ADD halo) into one straight-alpha RGBA image that the flipbook branch then draws with MIX; an ADD layer over white is invisible live but a MIX sprite of its baked colour is not — state which layers exist in the frozen_orb_v3 impact effect and their blend modes, and whether ONE flipbook can reproduce the stack over an arbitrary ground at all. (b) CLOCK — the flipbook index advances once per rendered frame (captures) while the live effect advances by effect-age under Engine.time_scale (hit-stop) and its own emission schedule; find where the two clocks diverge (the ground 55–62 and black 101–105 windows) and name the cause (hit-stop, a late-expiring child, particle lifetime, one-frame offset).

THEN BUILD, minimal and backward-compatible: (1) per-blend-class bakes — run_replay(..., bake=True, bake_layer='add'|'mix'|'all') hides the other class's nodes so each bake holds one blend class (default 'all' keeps today's output byte-identical); (2) the flipbook branch replays one Sprite2D per baked class with a CanvasItemMaterial of the matching blend mode (ADD for 'add', MIX for 'mix'), NEAREST filter as today, and advances the frame by the effect-age clock the live effect uses (physics frames scaled by Engine.time_scale), not by capture count; (3) export/replay.py gains plate_envelope_comparison(project, out, baked, grounds=('ground','black','white','foliage'), foliage_crop=None, tau=8, frames=126): captures plate (effect hidden) / live / flipbook per ground, envelope per frame = count of pixels with max-channel |composite − plate| > tau, returns compare_vo1-shaped rows (subject '<ground>/<frame>', relative_difference, tolerance 0.05, equal frame counts enforced, zero baseline requires exact zero) plus a summary {ground: {frames, failed, worst_frame, live_peak, flip_peak}}; (4) unit tests (unittest, stdlib): a synthetic ADD-over-white case proving the old single-sprite MIX replay fails and the per-class replay passes on a two-colour synthetic stack; a synthetic clock case (a 3-frame time_scale 0.1 hold) proving the flipbook index tracks effect-age; the envelope function on synthetic frames with a known count.
ACCEPTANCE (report exact numbers in runs/C-5/t3/T4g/acceptance.json): on the vo1_v21 project, the per-class flipbook replay vs live over ground, black, white (foliage if runs/C-5/baselines/foliage.png fits the crop) is within ± 5 % relative on ≥ 95 % of frames per ground, OR the diagnosis names precisely which layer/blend/clock element cannot be flattened into a flipbook and quantifies its per-frame contribution — report-not-stop (V17); never loosen the ± 5 %. Then run the FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected: all green except the five standing reds (test_f04_outside_at_least_three; three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid); report tests_run, successful, and name every red.

TEST CLEANUP (conductor R-C5-42, £0, no production change): six tests written for superseded clauses now fail on the accepted T4o build and must be ALIGNED, not weakened blindly: tests/test_effect_kit.py RaggedResidueMaterialTests.test_noise_bounds_band_resistance_endpoints_and_dissolve and .test_t4e_entry_ragged_connected_and_zero_disc_control (retained T4n-r1 band-proxy assertions → encode the T4o continuous-texture behaviour: erode_noise 0.4, noise_band_mix 0.5/0.5, entry 15–25 %, radius ratio ≥ 1.5, excess ≥ 0.35, zero-noise disc control); tests/test_godot_import.py RaggedResidueImportTests.test_exported_threshold_and_every_root_and_stretch_material_agree (→ the T4o exported thresholds); tests/test_godot_import.py TransformedResidueSeamTests.test_transformed_front_at_three_ages_has_no_straight_seam_over_12px (ages 30/33/36) — the ≤ 12 px seam clause is WITHDRAWN (seams are the geometric piece boundaries and pass to E0-p step 5): convert to a REPORT-ONLY measurement (assert it runs and records the segment lengths; no threshold). Read those two test files for this purpose.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4g/ (and reading runs/C-5/t3/T4c/conductor/vo1_v21/), any existing test other than tests/test_replay.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py and tests/test_godot_import.py (the named alignments only). Existing functions keep their signatures and defaults. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4g/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed or added with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4g"): files = every changed/added path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with the diagnosis summary in concerns.
